text: Timing of create moved 1-3% between builds whose `merge_sort` machine code was byte-identical, at `dc7dd45` and `4fbfbad` on the 50 MB synthetic input. Building with `-C llvm-args=-align-all-functions=12` brought the builds within ±0.4%, so code placement caused the swing. A create delta under 3% with unchanged instruction counts is within that swing. Details on sufr-8073a8.
